blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A modern jeepney operator was issued a show-cause order after allegedly overcharging passengers, the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) said Wednesday. According to the LTFRB, the operator was summoned amid an ongoing investigation over the incident, particularly on whether it was the operator who ordered the modern jeepney conductor to charge passengers more than the mandated fare.
